use_cases: Scroll-triggered image galleries with blur-to-clear reveal animations
Product showcases with smooth spring-based motion transitions
Landing page sections requiring depth-creating 3D perspective transforms
Portfolio and content sections needing smooth scroll-driven animations
Creative websites and agencies showcasing visual content with motion effects
ai_summary: A scroll-animated gallery container system that provides scroll context for child elements using React context and motion hooks. Features blur-to-reveal animations with spring physics, 3D perspective transforms for depth effects, and sticky positioning capabilities for creating immersive scroll-driven gallery experiences in landing pages and portfolio sites.
